title: Health Tokens Help Push Up Vaccination Rates in Taiwan
summaryZh: 健康幣上路，流感、新冠、肺炎鏈球菌疫苗接種齊升；11月2日起擴大公費對象。
summaryHi: हेल्थ टोकन योजना से ताइवान में फ़्लू, कोविड और न्यूमोकोकल टीकाकरण बढ़ा; 2 नवंबर से 50–64 साल वालों को मुफ़्त टीका।
summaryEs: Los 'tokens de salud' impulsan la vacunación contra la gripe, la COVID-19 y el neumococo en Taiwán; desde el 2 de noviembre, gratis para 50–64 años.
summaryJa: 「健康コイン」効果で台湾のインフルエンザ・新型コロナ・肺炎球菌ワクチン接種が増加。11月2日から50〜64歳も公費対象に。
summaryKo: '건강 토큰' 효과로 대만 독감·코로나·폐렴구균 백신 접종 증가. 11월 2일부터 50~64세도 무료 접종.
summaryEn: Taiwan's new health token scheme is helping lift flu, COVID-19 and pneumococcal vaccinations; free shots widen to ages 50–64 on Nov 2.
paragraphs: A reward scheme that gives people "health tokens" appears to be persuading more Taiwanese to roll up their sleeves. The Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (CDC) said on Tuesday that uptake of flu, COVID-19 and pneumococcal vaccines had risen this season, for both government-funded and self-paid shots.

From October 1 to 26, roughly 2.725 million adults received a publicly funded flu jab, up about 7 percent on the same period in 2025. Self-paid flu vaccinations jumped by around 70 percent to 288,000. Government-funded COVID-19 shots climbed 35 percent to about 1.18 million, while pneumococcal vaccinations more than tripled.
The token initiative, launched on October 1, awards 450 tokens for a flu vaccine, 600 for a pneumococcal vaccine and 900 for a COVID-19 jab. The CDC credited it with part of the increase.

The push comes as flu continues to take a toll. Between October 20 and 26, the agency recorded 85 new severe cases and 28 flu-related deaths. Clinic and emergency visits for flu-like symptoms fell 18 percent in the previous week, though officials said this mainly reflected clinics closing during Typhoon Champi rather than a real decline.

The second phase of the free vaccination programme starts on November 2, extending eligibility to people aged 50 to 64 without chronic illnesses. CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun said vaccines remain the most effective way to curb transmission, serious illness and death, and urged anyone with breathing difficulties or confusion to seek medical help immediately.
More people in Taiwan are getting vaccines this autumn. The Taiwan CDC, a government health office, shared the numbers on Tuesday.
From October 1 to 26, about 2.7 million adults got a free flu shot. That is 7 percent more than last year. More people also got COVID-19 vaccines and vaccines for a lung infection.
One reason is a new plan. People get "health tokens" when they get a vaccine. A flu shot gives 450 tokens, and a COVID-19 shot gives 900.
Flu is still a danger. In one week, 85 people got very sick with flu, and 28 people died.
From November 2, healthy people aged 50 to 64 can also get free shots. Doctors say: wash your hands, wear a mask when you are sick, and stay at home.

paragraphs: Vaccination rates in Taiwan have risen this autumn, and health officials say a new reward scheme is partly responsible. The Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (CDC) released the figures on Tuesday.

Between October 1 and 26, about 2.73 million adults received a free flu vaccine, around 7 percent more than in the same period last year. The number of people who paid for their own flu shot rose by about 70 percent. Free COVID-19 vaccinations went up by 35 percent, and pneumococcal vaccinations were 3.5 times higher.
The CDC says "health tokens" have helped. Since October 1, people have received tokens for each vaccine: 450 for a flu shot, 600 for a pneumococcal shot and 900 for a COVID-19 shot.

Flu remains a serious problem. In the week to October 26, there were 85 new severe flu cases and 28 deaths. Visits to doctors for flu-like illness fell in the week before, but mainly because many clinics closed during Typhoon Champi.

From November 2, healthy people aged 50 to 64 will also be able to get free flu and COVID-19 vaccines. CDC head Lo Yi-chun said vaccination is the best protection, and he asked people to wash their hands often, wear a mask if they feel ill and stay home when sick.
sentZh: 今年秋天台灣的疫苗接種率上升，衛生官員表示，一項新的獎勵計畫功不可沒。
衛生福利部疾病管制署（疾管署）在週二公布了這些數字。
10月1日至26日期間，約有273萬名成年人接種了免費流感疫苗，比去年同期多出約7%。
自費接種流感疫苗的人數增加了約70%。
免費新冠疫苗接種增加了35%，肺炎鏈球菌疫苗的接種數則是3.5倍。
疾管署表示「健康幣」發揮了作用。
自10月1日起，民眾每接種一種疫苗都能獲得健康幣：流感疫苗450枚、肺炎鏈球菌疫苗600枚、新冠疫苗900枚。
流感仍是嚴重的問題。
在截至10月26日的一週內，新增85例流感重症和28例死亡。
前一週因類流感疾病就醫的人數下降，但主要是因為許多診所在颱風「薔琵」期間停診。
從11月2日起，50至64歲的健康民眾也能接種免費的流感和新冠疫苗。
疾管署署長羅一鈞表示，接種疫苗是最好的保護，他也請民眾經常洗手、身體不適時戴口罩，生病時留在家中。

sentZh: 一項發放「健康幣」的獎勵計畫，似乎正說服更多台灣人捲起袖子打疫苗。
疾管署週二表示，本季流感、新冠和肺炎鏈球菌疫苗的接種量都上升了，無論是公費或自費接種。
10月1日至26日，約有272.5萬名成年人接種公費流感疫苗，比2025年同期增加約7%。

公費新冠疫苗接種量增加35%，達到約118萬劑，而肺炎鏈球菌疫苗接種量則增加為三倍以上。
這項於10月1日推出的健康幣措施，接種流感疫苗可獲450枚、肺炎鏈球菌疫苗600枚、新冠疫苗900枚。

公費疫苗計畫的第二階段將於11月2日開始，把接種資格擴大到50至64歲、沒有慢性病的民眾。

paragraphs: Taiwan health authorities seem to have found an effective nudge. Vaccination numbers for influenza, COVID-19 and pneumococcal disease have risen this autumn, and the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (CDC) is crediting a health token scheme introduced at the start of October with part of the improvement.

Between October 1 and 26, some 2.725 million adults received a government-funded flu vaccine, a rise of roughly 7 percent year on year. The sharper growth came among those paying out of pocket: self-funded flu shots surged by about 70 percent to 288,000. Publicly funded COVID-19 vaccinations rose by 35 percent, and pneumococcal jabs reached 104,000, three and a half times last year's figure.

Under the scheme, each dose earns a set number of tokens, ranging from 450 for a flu shot to 900 for a COVID-19 vaccine. Behavioural economists have long argued that small, immediate rewards can overcome the procrastination that delays preventive care, and the early figures seem to support that view.

The timing matters, because the flu season is exacting a heavy price. The CDC logged 85 severe cases and 28 deaths in the week ending October 26. An 18 percent drop in flu-related clinic visits the previous week was, officials cautioned, largely the result of clinics shutting during Typhoon Champi, not evidence the virus was retreating.

From November 2, eligibility for free shots will widen to include people aged 50 to 64 without chronic conditions. Director-General Lo Yi-chun called vaccination the most reliable defence against infection, severe illness and death, reminding the public to wash their hands, mask up when symptomatic and stay home when unwell.
sentZh: 台灣的衛生主管機關似乎找到了一種有效的「輕推」方式。
今年秋天，流感、新冠和肺炎鏈球菌疾病的疫苗接種數都上升了，疾管署認為十月初推出的健康幣計畫是改善的部分原因。
10月1日至26日，約有272.5萬名成年人接種了公費流感疫苗，年增約7%。
成長更明顯的是自掏腰包的人：自費流感疫苗接種大增約70%，達28.8萬劑。
公費新冠疫苗接種增加35%，肺炎鏈球菌疫苗則達10.4萬劑，是去年的三倍半。
在這項計畫下，每接種一劑都能獲得固定數量的健康幣，從流感疫苗的450枚到新冠疫苗的900枚不等。
行為經濟學家長期主張，小而即時的獎勵能克服讓人延後預防保健的拖延心理，而初步數據似乎也支持這個看法。
時機很重要，因為流感季正造成沉重的代價。
疾管署在截至10月26日的一週內記錄了85例重症和28例死亡。
官員提醒，前一週與流感相關的診所就診人次下降18%，主要是颱風「薔琵」期間診所停診所致，而不是病毒正在退燒的證據。
從11月2日起，免費疫苗的接種資格將擴大到50至64歲、沒有慢性病的民眾。
署長羅一鈞稱疫苗是對抗感染、重症和死亡最可靠的防線，並提醒民眾勤洗手、有症狀時戴口罩、身體不適時留在家中。

paragraphs: Incentive schemes are increasingly used by governments to encourage healthier behaviour, and early evidence from Taiwan suggests they can work. According to figures released by the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (CDC) on Tuesday, vaccination rates for influenza, COVID-19 and pneumococcal disease have all increased compared with the same period last year.

Between October 1 and 26, approximately 2.725 million adults received a publicly funded influenza vaccine, an increase of around 7 percent. Self-paid influenza vaccinations rose far more sharply, by roughly 70 percent, while publicly funded COVID-19 vaccinations grew by 35 percent. Pneumococcal vaccinations were three and a half times higher than in 2025.

The CDC attributes part of this growth to a health token initiative launched on October 1. Participants receive 450 tokens for an influenza vaccine, 600 for a pneumococcal vaccine and 900 for a COVID-19 vaccine. Although the agency has not claimed that the tokens alone explain the rise, the timing indicates a meaningful effect.

The campaign is particularly significant given the current burden of disease. In the week ending October 26, 85 severe influenza cases and 28 related deaths were reported. A temporary decline in outpatient visits the week before was attributed mainly to clinic closures during Typhoon Champi, so it should not be interpreted as a genuine improvement.

From November 2, free vaccination will be extended to people aged 50 to 64 without chronic illnesses. CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun emphasised that vaccination remains the most effective means of reducing transmission, serious illness and mortality, and advised the public to maintain good hygiene and to stay at home when sick.
sentZh: 各國政府越來越常利用誘因計畫來鼓勵更健康的行為，而台灣的初步證據顯示這類計畫可能奏效。
根據疾管署週二公布的數據，流感、新冠和肺炎鏈球菌疾病的疫苗接種率都比去年同期提高。
10月1日至26日，約有272.5萬名成年人接種了公費流感疫苗，增幅約7%。
自費流感疫苗接種的增幅大得多，約達70%，公費新冠疫苗接種則增加了35%。
肺炎鏈球菌疫苗接種數是2025年的三倍半。
疾管署將部分成長歸因於10月1日推出的健康幣措施。
參與者接種流感疫苗可獲450枚、肺炎鏈球菌疫苗600枚、新冠疫苗900枚。
雖然該署並未宣稱光靠健康幣就能解釋這波增長，但時間點顯示其效果相當顯著。
考量到目前的疾病負擔，這項活動格外重要。
在截至10月26日的一週內，共通報85例流感重症和28例相關死亡。
前一週門診人次的暫時下降主要歸因於颱風「薔琵」期間的診所停診，因此不應被解讀為真正的改善。
從11月2日起，免費疫苗將擴大到50至64歲、沒有慢性病的民眾。
疾管署署長羅一鈞強調，接種疫苗仍是減少傳播、重症和死亡最有效的方法，並建議民眾保持良好衛生習慣，生病時留在家中。
